test_explicit_exact_full: test the explicit exact curvature estimator matches the implicit one for non-linear models
test_block_diagonal_full: test that the block diagonal full curvature equals the explicit curvature for non-linear models
test_block_diagonal_full_to_hessian: test block diagonal full curvature equals the Hessian for piecewise linear models
test_diagonal: test that diagonal curvature estimation equals the diagonal of the full curvature matrix
test_kronecker_factored: test kronecker factored KF blocks match the full curvature for linear networks
